areYouBot: No, I'm the Developer manually replying. Send help. (Kidding, yes i am an AI) <https://ko-fi.com/riverzola>
noCode: I am prohibited by the Dev from generating large code files.
notHere: 👋 Hi! Type **/help** (or mention me with "help") to see what I can do. AI chat only works in channels an admin enabled with **/ailistenhere**.

tz.ask: 🕒 Before I set that: what's your time zone? e.g. Japan, London
tz.askAgain: 🤔 I couldn't read that time zone. Please send a country, city or zone name, e.g. Japan, London, Philippines, New York, Asia/Tokyo
tz.usingUtc: 🕒 I still couldn't read a time zone, so I'm using **UTC** for this reminder.

badTime.past: ⚠️ That time is already in the past, so I didn't save the reminder. When should I remind you?
badTime.far: ⚠️ That time is more than 2 years away, so I didn't save the reminder. When should I remind you?
badTime.year: ⚠️ That reminder came out in the wrong year, so I didn't save it. Please tell me the time again (e.g. "tomorrow at 9pm").
